subject.title: 🦞 Tracking: Onboard the channels & providers I use

question: Should completion require every named channel-provider combination, or a smaller representative matrix with separate tracking for security-sensitive connection modes?
rationale: The current checklist combines established wizard failures, regression automation, and a new connection-mode feature; code inspection cannot determine the intended release boundary.

options.title: Representative matrix plus separate connect work
options.body: Require representative Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Gemini, Copilot, and LM Studio coverage while tracking OAuth and connection hooks independently.

options.title: Every named combination
options.body: Keep all named channel-provider pairs and connection modes inside this epic's completion contract.

options.title: Bugs only
options.body: Narrow the epic to existing onboarding regressions and move all new capability and automation work to separate roadmap items.

recommendation.title: Representative matrix plus separate connect work
recommendation.body: Require representative Telegram, Discord, WhatsApp, Gemini, Copilot, and LM Studio coverage while tracking OAuth and connection hooks independently.

likelyOwner.reason: She owns the epic and its combination-validation child and recently reaffirmed that the roll-up should remain active.
